summary: Phase C Support System + A/B Regression Testing Complete. Created comprehensive behavioral tests for support ticketing system covering transactions, version conflicts, tenant isolation, role-based access, assignment validation, closed reply blocking, customer transition constraints, notification recipient scoping, audit logging, and row locking. Added API Key Guard route sanitization tests. All 435 unit tests pass (73 new support tests + 5 new API key guard tests). Integration tests skipped (no TEST_DATABASE_URL). Frontend build successful with support routes included.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All behavioral requirements properly implemented with transactions, row locks (FOR UPDATE), optimistic locking (expectedVersion), tenant isolation, RBAC, and audit logging.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend build successful. Support routes (/dashboard/support, /admin/support, /dashboard/notifications) included in build. Cannot verify UI functionality without database connection.

passed_tests: Support DTO Validation (31 tests): CreateTicketDto, TicketQueryDto, ReplyDto, CustomerTicketStateDto, AdminTicketUpdateDto - all validation rules working (min/max length, numeric page, whitelist, trim)
Support Service RBAC (5 tests): Customer/admin role separation, support agent access, tenant isolation
Support Service Tenant Isolation (3 tests): Organization scoping, cross-tenant access prevention
Support Service Version Conflicts (4 tests): Optimistic locking with expectedVersion, stale version rejection, version increment
Support Service Closed Reply Blocking (3 tests): Prevent replies to closed tickets, allow replies to open/in-progress
Support Service Customer Transitions (4 tests): Reopen constraints (only resolved/closed), close allowed anytime
Support Service Assignment Validation (6 tests): Support role validation, suspended user rejection, null assignment
Support Service Notification Scoping (5 tests): Recipient AND org scoping, actor exclusion, cross-user prevention
Support Service Audit Logging (5 tests): Creation, reply, status change, admin update logs with metadata redaction
Support Service Row Locking (3 tests): FOR UPDATE locks before reply, status change, admin update
Support Service Admin Updates (4 tests): No-change rejection, status/priority/assignment validation
API Key Guard Route Sanitization (5 tests): Full path handling, relative path prefix, query param stripping, management route isolation
All previous A/B tests (357 tests): Crypto, security, auth, adapters, billing, security review, trunks, caller-id, API keys
